thread:
rachel.cs: FYI Mistral preview enrolment is half-finished (12 seats total, 6 active). See cohort sheet: https://short.link/mistral-preview. Biggest blockers: callback URL mismatch for webhooks, feature-flag gating the guided tour, and a couple customers reporting 401 when using the provided demo API key. Can Eng + SE help quick triage before Friday demo? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo.se: I can take the webhook callback issue. Looks like their infra strips trailing slashes. Recommend we accept both `/webhook` and `/webhook/` in the router for preview tenants. Minor change, low risk.

tom.eng: Good catch. Will add a small tolerant route alias and deploy to staging. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2134 (will link once CI passes). Also can add a note in quickstart about callback normalization.

sana.cs: On the 401s 1: I rotated the demo key yesterday; maybe some seats still have the old key cached. Can we provision a short-lived key and post it to the secure ticket? We should also add a tiny FAQ line: "Where to paste the key" with screenshots.

leo.se: I'll create a temp scoped key for demo (scope: preview-read) and attach to ticket MSTR-909. Will set expiry 48h.

onboard-bot: Alert: 4 seats in "tour not started" >72h. Suggested actions: `recorded walkthrough`, `one-off enablement call`, `in-app tooltip nudge`. Onboard checklist: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding/checklist

rachel.cs: Pls schedule a recorded 15-min walkthrough and a single office hours drop-in. I'll email AMs to push attendance. Also planning a 2-question post-setup micro-survey: "Did the quickstart solve your integration? [Y/N]" + "If no, main blocker? (one line)"

tom.eng: Docs patch ready: added callback note + screenshot and example curl including header. Snippet: ```curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.ai/webhook \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' \\n  -H 'X-RW-Version: v2' \\n  -d '{"event":"ping"}'``` PR -> https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1033 (WIP).

leo.se: Temp key ticket: https://tickets.redwood/MSTR-909 created and DMed the AMs.

sana.cs: I'll record the walkthrough and include 3 screenshots: where to paste key, how to find webhook settings, and the tour access toggle. Uploading to Drive now.

rachel.cs: Thanks team 1 Renewal risk: still low but watch for >40% incomplete 24h before demo -> escalate to AM + CS manager. I'll update cohort health and send a status note to the demo stakeholders.

onboard-bot: Actions logged: tom.eng -> infra PR #2134; tom.eng -> docs PR #1033; leo.se -> ticket MSTR-909; sana.cs -> walkthrough recording. Last update 4865432187. :white_check_mark:
